oneOf.description: Resolve a tap on the current draft, including earlier wires. Optional net or member restricts the intended Net; a tap joining a different crossing Net is rejected.
Net ID or name; choose its nearest route to the other endpoint on the current draft.

Opt-in, bounded one-pass placement of visible default Instance labels. Compact/collision avoidance default true. Preserve manually positioned, locked and custom-styled labels, bindings and electrical names; unresolved clashes remain observations.

Explicit selection. Includes owned displays and formal interface declarations, and, as in the GUI, a wire that only tapped a deleted part into other wiring. Select all object IDs for complete Cell deletion.

commands.description: Ordered atomic route-net, label, model, display, annotation move, direction, VDD mode or terminal removal commands; one undo, no partial commit. Total expanded edit limit still applies.

instances.description: A part without a reference takes the next free name, as a GUI insert does.

pinAnchors.description: By new Instance ID. Solves placement.position from this pin; preserves rotation/mirror. No implicit connection.

scope.description: Defaults to the existing Net scope, otherwise local; global must be intentional.

oneOf.description: Set a straight Power Rail's two ends on its own line. Taps and the one label stay; no pin is joined.

placement.description: Origin and orientation. With pinAnchor only the orientation is read; left out, the part goes upright and unmirrored.

reference.description: X and a number; omit it for the next free one, as the GUI names a Cell instance.

__schema376.description: When supplied, solves the origin instead of using placement.position; keeps orientation.

__schema377.description: Exact routing grid landing, not artwork contact. Unreachable positions are rejected with the nearest reachable landing.

target.description: Current Net ID/name, member pin, explicit pins to join, or an original import-reference Net. Routes only missing visible connections.

trunk.description: Straight horizontal/vertical trunk; otherwise use MST guidance. Atomic, not an obstacle autorouter.

__schema386.description: Move an existing Junction and reshape every incident Route atomically; preserve connectivity and respect protected geometry.

__schema391.description: Show text on a part's name label while the part keeps its own Reference (or Pin name) in the netlist, e.g. an op-amp X1 drawn A1; null shows its own name again. Survives Project Code and Copy as the label's text.

__schema397.description: Absolute drawing position; preserve electrical binding and object ownership.
